facts.text: Last night before the campers arrive. One round, then everyone back to the lodge before dark. I mean it.
facts.why: Paul offers the trainees one last night in town before training starts. A night at the bar runs into the evening, so 'before dark' clashes, and the trainees are not campers yet. The sources do not give Paul these words.
facts.fix: Last night in town before training starts. One round, then everyone back to camp. I mean it.

facts.why: The plot has Muffin as Terry's dog, who turns up at the cabin door near the end. Nothing opened shows him wandering into the woods.

vibe.verdict: A fair bar tab for the last night in town, but it skips the film's best moments, like Ginny wearing Pamela's sweater in the shack.
missing: Ginny puts on Pamela's sweater to fool Jason (the shack)
Pamela's severed head on the altar (the shack)
Crazy Ralph: 'You're all doomed' (the road, before the garrotte)
Deputy Winslow's chase into the woods (the shack)
Mark and Vickie's handheld video games (the lodge)
Jason's burlap sack mask (used only as a pudding name)
ideas: Swap the 'Receipt' stamp for a Crazy Ralph chalkboard special: 'You're all doomed' (a quote said by Ralph in the film)
Swap 'Sack-head s'mores bars' for 'Pamela's sweater' cardigan-knit shortbread, with a note about Ginny's trick
Swap 'Pitcher of draught beer' note for a nod to Winslow finding the shack
Rename 'Camp Blood chilli' to 'Shack chilli' and tie it to Ginny's hiding place
